Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear note. Short answers below and I attached a PDF of a recent invoice for reference (nr_sample_invoice.pdf).

1) If we invoice from our Norway HQ (org no. 987654321) to a Redwood entity in another country, we treat it as an export of goods/services from Norway. Norway does not charge VAT on exports — you should not see Norwegian VAT.

2) If we invoice from the UK branch (GB 123 4567 89), whether we charge UK VAT depends on where the supply is made and your company VAT registration. For Redwood EU Ltd (GB VAT: GB999999999), the invoice would normally be zero-rated provided we have your valid VAT number and the supply qualifies as B2B (reverse charge). If supply is UK domestic, we would include UK VAT. We can mark the invoice with the appropriate reverse-charge wording.

3) Preferred e-invoice address is accounts@nordicresellers.no for both entities, but we can send separate entity headers (billing party name + VAT/Org ID) depending on which entity you request on the PO.

I'll return the populated PO_Entity_Mapping_Template by EOD. If it helps, I can loop in our tax advisor (Bjorn) for any complex cross-border phrasing.

Regards,
Ingrid S.

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Internal guidance from Tax/Finance (copied below) and proposed PO approach: 

- If invoice originates from Norway HQ: route to Redwood AS (NO) AP code. No VAT should be on the invoice; require Norwegian org number and bank details.
- If invoice originates from UK branch: route to Redwood EU Ltd (GB). Require their UK VAT registration number on invoice and include reverse-charge text. Redwood EU Ltd will account for VAT under reverse charge; vendor should not charge VAT if we provide our VAT ID.
- Preferred operational approach: raise two linked POs (one per billing entity) rather than a single split PO. Two POs reduces accounting friction and keeps remitting entity clear. Use invoice matching to link the POs back to a single contract number.

Required invoice fields to avoid PO hold: billing entity name, billing entity tax id, invoice currency, invoice number, invoice date, PO number, line-item product codes, net amount, VAT amount (if any), bank details. If vendor cannot provide separate invoices per entity, treat UK-branch invoices as separate document and route by billing header.

I'll flag to AP ops to create Redwood EU Ltd PO template with the reverse-charge instructions pre-filled. Ben — can you own PO creation (two linked POs) and follow up if vendor needs changes?

Karthik
